svg.title: Output console mockup (dark theme)
svg.desc: The Output panel docked with Problems and History. The toolbar holds the Levels and Subsystems dropdowns, the search box in Find mode with "3 of 3" and match arrows, Pause, Follow and Wrap toggles, Copy, Save and Clear, the View menu and the buffer ring. The list shows thirteen log lines with an exception glyph, time, level tag, subsystem token and message columns, a folded warning with a x14 badge, two find highlights and the selected error, whose details pane is open below. Below the panel: the Subsystems menu, the View menu, the row context menu and the buffer flyout. Numbered notes on the right explain each element.

g.text: 8,580 entries until the oldest are overwritten
Level mask with its summary on the button.
Built from the subsystems seen; unchecking
hides one. New subsystems show by default.
Funnel off: every row stays, matches are
highlighted, F3 / Shift+F3 move between them.
Funnel on: Filter mode hides non-matching rows.
Pause freezes this view only; capture goes on
and the label reads "Paused · 37 new". Jumping
to a match or scrolling up turned Follow off.
retained entry. Clear: empties the buffer.
Ring buffer occupancy. Turns caution once older
entries are overwritten; never red, since a full
buffer is normal in a long session.
Exception glyph, time, level tag, subsystem
token: fixed widths, neutral colors. Only
14 consecutive identical warnings, timed at the
latest; the tooltip gives the range. Copy and
Save write all 14; the buffer keeps all 14.
Selected by F3. It matched in its exception,
so the accent highlight is in Details; other
Follows the selection; resizable. Message and
exception on the left, properties on the right.
Copy details copies the full record. Esc closes.
